newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 19.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- President Jacques Chirac in Japan reaffirms will go ahead with austerity policy despite political cost and negative impact on public opinion .
-- GAN chairman Jean-Jacques Bonnaud refuses to heed government call to resign over the postponed privatisation of GAN banking subsidiary CIC.
-- Building sector calls for government help to allow some 30,000 early retirements.
-- Theme park operator Euro Disney posts a 77 percent profit rise for year to Sept 30, but grace period under a current debt restructuring only runs for the next two years.
